To better sustain this project, I’m running a small, reversible experiment. For the next month, I am offering a matching fund for all new contributions. 

The hypothesis is simple: Does de-risking a donation actually increase engagement? If we hit our target, I’ll keep the matching program active to build on the momentum. If not, I’ll simply revert to our usual funding model. It is a low-cost way to test how we can grow without burning any bridges. I’d love to see if it works.
